QuestInfo.name: Like Pulling Strings
QuestInfo.0: #o9300500# seems to think that he needs all of the Seal Stones to bring back the Black Mage. It doesn't make any sense. Where could that information be coming from?
QuestInfo.1: #p1404000# refuses to talk any more about the leader of the Black Wings, but it's not your style to let a man walk away with something you want. Make him tell you what he knows.\n\n#rTip: If you can't defeat Francis, forfeit the quest and do it again.
QuestInfo.2: The leader of the Black Wings is Orchid. It's odd. She's not really the type to use her head. Maybe she's in league with #p1404005#. Either way, it doesn't appear #p1404000# knows anything about her.
